semiconductor_relevance: High — CeramTec provides essential ceramic components used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CeramTec GmbH specializes in advanced technical ceramics, offering high-performance ceramic components for the semiconductor industry. Their products are crucial for wafer handling, processing, and equipment applications, providing high thermal stability and long service life. The company collaborates with OEMs and fabs to deliver customized, application-optimized solutions.
capabilities: High-performance ceramic components for wafer handling
Customized ceramic parts for OEMs and fabs
Materials expertise in alumina, aluminum nitride, silicon carbide, and silicon nitride
